scope: One static ibm_kingston job on the backup account: the state-prep-control arms prep0, x_remeasure and remeasure on qubits 147, 148, 149, 141, 142 and 143, 32768 shots at a 20 us repetition delay, under a 12 s ceiling. It decides whether q147's preparation excess is a population the first read finds or a misassignment of that read, through the persistence of a second measurement, and reads the readout-event link and q142 descriptively. The case is results/live/PRIMORIAL_Q147_REMEASURE_CASE.md and the analysis scripts/remeasure_history.py; the gap-88 circuits and the split law stay out of scope.
